mission.title: Just the Facts Ma'am
mission.description: Find out what a bluepill witness saw of the hardline sabotage.

phase.briefing: Someone is sabotaging hardlines throughout the City. Several bluepills have witnessed the acts of sabotage. You will interview one of these bluepill witnesses and find out what they know about the saboteurs.

enter.say: The witness, Tonisha Warren, resides in that apartment building. Find her and extract the information we need. There is no particular need to be... gentle.
Interesting. Tonisha Warren appears to have ceased function. I suggest searching the body.

done.say: This key belongs to an office nearby. Maybe there are more clues there. Leave the building and I'll update your waypoint with the office's location.

phase.briefing: You have received the office building's location. Proceed there swiftly.

enter.say: The office is in that building. I'll point the door out when you get near it. Be on your guard--I'm picking up multiple foreign signals in the area.
There's the door that Tonisha Warren's key will fit.
Search this room carefully. Tonisha Warren may have left some sort of clue about what she saw at the hardline.

done.say: Ah, this dossier contains notes she made about what she saw at the hardline sabotage. Leave the area and upload it at a hardline.

objective.text: Upload the dossier at a hardline

mission.finish: Her notes in the dossier indicate quite clearly that it was these same imposter programs who were present at the hardline sabotage incident. Good. Now we will know in what direction to proceed.
